observed_result: Two ten-cell matrices ran the same wiring and the same parameter set through the two cores, one after the other, both exit 0 and neither with a non-finite value. (1) The two matrices are the same graph and the same parameters, checked cell by cell and not only at the top. Both reports carry the same graph hashes, the same parameter_set_sha256 and the same three resolved sets with the same counts and the same node hashes (alin 24 nodes a507a3db..., descending_neuron 1,314 nodes 9a43073e..., vnc_motor 708 nodes b48e2ee9...). For all ten cells the variant name, the seed, the run report's topology_hash and its parameter_hash are identical between the two matrices, and the whole null_model block, including attempts, applied and both rejection counts, is identical as well. Because the two matrices are two separate processes, that is also a reproduction result: degree_preserving_rewire seed 1 derived the same 25,235,685 applied swaps and the same topology hash 61f510d956c27733... in both processes, seed 2 the same 25,234,331 and 089026eb..., seed 3 the same 25,233,927 and c90cd107..., and each sign_shuffle and weight_shuffle seed reproduced its parameter hash exactly. The original wiring keeps topology hash 5d205bf8f77e988334457defacdf1c0294f29aa75bbc8246641ff25295ed7391 and parameter hash 2a93e2b0f37b6821df525d6bbb9e21365d4047b54c63b346c99d806137b6664a in both matrices, and the two shuffles leave that topology hash untouched while the rewire leaves that parameter hash untouched. (2) Which metrics exist on which core. None of the four event metrics exists on the continuous core: it emits no events, so population_rate_per_step is empty, rate_quantiles are all zero, and spike_fraction, mean_rate, latency_to_first_spike and activity_ratio_vs_baseline are rejected by the protocol validator before any run starts. mean_output is the only metric kind the continuous core can produce and it is the only kind the continuous protocol declares. The spiking protocol declares the four event metrics and no mean_output, so no metric kind is literally shared between the two matrices; what is shared is the graph, the parameter set, the stimulus, the three named sets and two of the step windows, [10,300) and [30,300). The comparison across cores is therefore between percentile patterns for the same set over the same window, not between metric values. (3) Continuous core, original wiring: alin mean_output 0.08335703984313853 over [10,300) (580.1649973082441 over 24 nodes x 290 steps) and 0.04322136524561577 over [30,300); descending_neuron 0.07222063513885349 and 0.07500580956796916; vnc_motor -0.008258249806206836 and -0.00360833176897489, both negative, which a tanh activation can be and a spike fraction cannot. silent_fraction is 0.004451254224149417, counting neurons whose output never left the value held before the run. Every metric was defined in every cell of this matrix, so no percentile is missing here, unlike the spiking matrix where vnc_motor_activity_ratio has no value on the original wiring. (5) How the two cores compare. The comparable pairs are the rate-like readouts of the same set over the same window: mean_rate over [30,300) on the spiking core against mean_output over [30,300) on the continuous one. Against sign_shuffle the two cores agree everywhere: the original sits at percentile 0, below all three seeds, for alin, descending_neuron and vnc_motor on both cores, so permuting the signs raises the readout above the real assignment whichever core reads it. Against degree_preserving_rewire they agree on alin (percentile 1 on both) and on vnc_motor (0 on the spiking core, 0.3333333333333333 on the continuous one) but disagree on descending_neuron: percentile 0 on the spiking core, where every rewired seed is above the original, and percentile 1 on the continuous core, where every rewired seed is below it. Against weight_shuffle they disagree on descending_neuron the same way (0 against 1) and partly on alin (0 against 0.3333333333333333), while vnc_motor is percentile 0 on both. The direction a whole-brain comparison reports is therefore not a property of the wiring alone: for this set and these null models it changes with the core that reads it, which is the reason the same matrix is run twice. Within the spiking matrix alone the four metric kinds already point different ways, which is the same warning seen from the other side: under every kind the original's descending_neuron and vnc_motor spike_fraction and mean_rate sit at percentile 0 while their latency and activity ratio sit at percentile 1. (6) Thresholds. Six were declared before the run, all of the form mean_output >= a fixed value (0.01 for the two alin metrics, 0.001 for the four others). On the original wiring the four alin and descending_neuron thresholds pass and both vnc_motor thresholds fail, because that set's mean output is negative. Across the null cells they split: all six pass in all three sign_shuffle seeds and in weight_shuffle seeds 1 and 3, all six fail in weight_shuffle seed 2, and the rewire seeds are mixed (seed 1 fails the four alin and descending_neuron thresholds and passes both vnc_motor ones, seed 2 is the same pattern as the original, seed 3 fails five of six). No threshold changed the exit status, which was 0. (7) Resources. The continuous matrix took 929.97 s wall (815.61 s user, 98.44 s sys) with 5,659,115,520 bytes maximum resident set size and 10,513,997,816 bytes peak memory footprint; its ten cells account for 890.16679004 s, per cell 87.916929625 (original), 87.756042, 86.83145625, 91.651246708 (rewire 1-3), 87.278312083, 89.725687041, 91.481091542 (sign_shuffle 1-3), 88.796758583, 87.071127292, 91.658138916 (weight_shuffle 1-3). The spiking matrix took 890.94 s wall with 5,909,626,880 bytes maximum resident set size and 9,543,671,152 bytes peak footprint. Neither hit the default 8 GiB accounted limit and neither dropped a seed, a step or an edge.
assumption_statement: Both matrices use parameter_source derived_release/v1 with one and the same parameter set file, so nothing here is a measurement. Edge signs are rule-derived from predicted transmitter probabilities under the rules file f9474a1be70ea2d008ff842311bd31de50d329eccf53a15d59a4b5b31c2566d0 (rules hash 9cb5aa45c96c1242a642257ab86fca7a7ae24df91159deeb3e48b90d10738ee1): argmax of the mean predicted probability over the matched T-bar points, acetylcholine +1, gaba -1, glutamate -1, histamine -1, dopamine, octopamine and serotonin unknown, min_probability 0.5, min_matched_fraction 0.5, and inhibitory glutamate in the fly is an engineering assumption recorded in the rule basis. The declared unknown_sign policy is exclude in both protocols, so each of the 2,754,056 unknown edges contributed weight zero. Strength is the raw release weight over the target's body-stats post count (gain 1, normalizer post_total) and weight_scale 21.6 is an engineering choice of units. bias 0, log_tau 0 and theta_raw 0 are uniform engineering values for every neuron in both matrices and every conduction delay is zero. The spiking core uses the LIF settings of NAT-01 and NAT-02: dt 1, tau_syn 5, theta_min 0.1, theta_max 2, v_reset -0.5, one refractory step, adaptation disabled, fast_sigmoid surrogate scale 2. The continuous core uses the scalar settings the package tests use, dt 1 and the tanh activation (dynamics.Config{DT: 1, Activation: "tanh"}, as in TestContinuousCoreRunsTheSameProtocolShape and the derived fixture protocol); no continuous setting was tuned for this run and no delay or topology was declared in the protocol, because the graph supplies both. The stimulus is identical in both protocols: one channel, 300 steps, a pulse of amplitude 2 into the 24 ALIN neurons over steps [10,30), gain 1. The two protocols differ in three places and only three: the core block, the probe reductions (the continuous protocol reads mean_output because the spiking reductions need events) and the metric kinds. The continuous protocol declares only min_active_fraction 0.01 as a stability threshold and deliberately omits max_population_rate, which cannot trigger on a core that emits no events and would have been a silently ignored knob. Null models are in-memory derivatives from math/rand/v2 rand.New(rand.NewPCG(seed, 0)) with seeds 1, 2 and 3, degree_preserving_rewire at swap_factor 1; neither the store nor the parameter set file was rewritten by either matrix. The six continuous thresholds (0.01, 0.01, 0.001, 0.001, 0.001, 0.001) were chosen and written into the protocol before the matrix was run, together with the protocol's SHA-256, and were not adjusted afterwards; two of them fail on the original wiring and are reported as failures. A pass means only "under this rule the set's metric reached the declared value".

limitations: No metric kind is shared between the two matrices. mean_output is the only kind the continuous core can produce, and the spiking protocol declares the four event kinds instead, although mean_output is available on the spiking core too. The cross-core statements above therefore compare percentile patterns for the same set and the same window, not two measurements of one quantity. Declaring mean_output on the spiking protocol as well would have given a literally shared metric; the protocol was written before the run and was not changed afterwards.
Three seeds per kind, so a percentile can only be 0, 1/6, 1/3, 1/2, 2/3, 5/6 or 1. It is a position in a distribution, not a test, and no test was declared.

The cores disagree about the direction of the rewire and weight_shuffle effects on the two output sets. That disagreement is reported, not resolved: nothing here says which core is the better model of anything.
One protocol pair, one stimulus, one unknown-sign policy, one weight_scale, one swap_factor and one machine (macOS arm64).
No behavioural claim. alin, descending_neuron and vnc_motor are annotation labels, and mean_output is a core state average, not a motor output.

degree_preserving_rewire preserves every in and out degree but not the self loop count: it refuses to create a self loop and can destroy one of the 101 the store's import report records among 25,563,197 edges.

Each matrix was executed once. The cell-by-cell agreement between the two processes verifies that the null model derivation is reproducible from the seed, but not that a whole compare report is byte identical on repetition; that is verified directly by the package and CLI tests on fixtures.

Wall time and maximum resident set size are single samples from a shared machine; the accounted memory limit is an arithmetic bound over the arrays this package allocates and excludes the loaded store, the parameter set arrays, allocator slack and runtime overhead that the measured resident set size includes.
